brief: What we look for when hiring engineers in 2026 (it's not coding tests).

slots.author: Maya Patel
slots.headline: Hiring Engineers in 2026: Beyond Code Tests
slots.body: Coding tests are fading. The best teams now screen for judgment, communication, and adaptability. Here is what actually matters.

slots.author: Maya Patel
slots.title: Systems Thinking Wins
slots.body: We care more about how you architect trade-offs than how fast you write loops. Can you simplify complexity?

slots.author: Maya Patel
slots.title: Prioritise Relentless Curiosity
slots.body: The half-life of skills is shrinking. We hire people who ask better questions and learn publicly, not those who memorise syntax.

slots.author: Maya Patel
slots.title: Communication Is Architecture
slots.body: If you cannot explain the why, you cannot scale the what. Great engineers write and speak with radical clarity.

slots.author: Maya Patel
slots.title: Practice Extreme Ownership
slots.body: We look for builders who debug culture, not just code. You own the blast radius and the follow-through.

slots.author: Maya Patel
slots.title: Embrace Rapid Adaptability
slots.body: Roadmaps change weekly. We value engineers who pivot with evidence, not panic, and turn ambiguity into momentum.

slots.author: Maya Patel
slots.title: Build Team-First Mindsets
slots.body: The hardest problems are solved by diverse minds. We screen for empathy, feedback, and shared credit.

slots.author: Maya Patel
slots.headline: Which Trait Matters Most?
slots.body: Share the one quality you prioritise when hiring engineers in 2026. I will read every comment.
